EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Apparently, today is a day for
pulling weeds.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Weeds get in the way when I jog, so
feel free to pull as many as you
want! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Parece que hoy toca arrancar
hierbajos!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Los hierbajos me estorban cuando
salgo a correr, ¡así que arranca
todos los que puedas! ¡Malditos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Apparemment, aujourd'hui, c'est le
jour où on désherbe la ville.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Il était
temps,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Je me prends les pattes dans les
mauvaises herbes en faisant mon
jogging quasiment tous les jours !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oggi è il giorno in cui dobbiamo
strappare via tutte le erbacce.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Io le odio, ci inciampo sempre
mentre corro. Quindi ne eliminerò
il più possibile, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Heute ist der große, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}einzigartige,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
absolut ultracoole {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Tag des Jätens{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Tob dich aus! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Jäte alles Unkraut,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}das dir in die Quere kommt!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Dann kann's mir auch nicht in die
Quere kommen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wenn ich jogge,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Anlaşılan bugün ot yolma
günüymüş.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Koşarken otlar ayağıma
dolanıyor, o yüzden istediğin kadarını
yol! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}They say cleaning can be a good
workout, right?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mopping up the floor, raking up
dead leaves{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Maybe you can get stronger just
by making your surroundings
prettier!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Limpiar es una forma de hacer
ejercicio, supongo...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Barrer el suelo, apartar las hojas
secas y todo eso{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Además no solo te pones cachas,
¡sino que hace que vivas en un
sitio más limpio! ¡Mira qué bien!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nettoyer, c'est pas mal pour se
maintenir en forme, pas vrai ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Passer le balai, entasser les
feuilles mortes{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ouaip, c'est ce qui s'appelle faire
d'une pierre deux coups, ha ha !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sapevi che ci si può allenare
anche facendo i lavori di casa?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Basta pulire i pavimenti, lavare
i piatti, togliere la polvere e
il gioco è fatto.
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Magari potresti mettere su un po'
di muscoli se ripulissi in giro!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Jäten ist eigentlich ein ziemlich
gutes Training, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Dieses ganze Rupfen und Zupfen
macht bestimmt dicke Arme{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Da soll mal einer sagen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}dass sich
Umweltschutz nicht lohnt!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Personne n'aime nettoyer, en
général,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Mais il suffit de faire passer ça pour
un événement et hop ! Les troupes
sont motivées !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ha ha !{{TAG:0007:0000:19000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}All this talk of weeding makes me
think it's a good day to do some
house cleaning, too.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}I should take this opportunity to
shine up all my training equipment!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Con todo eso que dicen de quitar
hierbajos, ¡supongo que este es
un buen día para hacer limpieza!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}¡Yo creo que debería sacarle brillo
a mis pesas! ¡Las tengo un poco
descuidadas últimamente!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}A furia di sentir parlare di strappare
erbacce... mi è venuta voglia di
dedicarmi un po' alle pulizie!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}I pesi e le panche hanno proprio
bisogno di una spolverata,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Bu kadar ot yolamaktan konuşunca evde
de temizlik yapmak
için iyi günmüş gibi geliyor.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Bütün
antrenman aletlerimi parlatmak
için tam fırsat!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}I always end up cleaning my house 
on {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Weeding Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, and I remember
how tough it is!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}I'm just starting to realize{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}my
mom is way more powerful than I
will ever be! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Como es el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Día del Hierbajo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} he
decidido hacer limpieza en casa,
pero es que... ¡es un rollazo!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Por fin me he dado cuenta de que{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}
¡mi madre tiene más fuerza de
voluntad de la que tendré yo nunca!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Pfiou, faire le ménage et désherber,
c'est super crevant, tu ne trouves
pas ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Je n'y avais jamais pensé, mais{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}ma
maman doit être plus balèze que je
ne le serai jamais,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Per la Giornata delle erbacce,
finisco sempre per pulire casa mia!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Farei volentieri i miei addominali,
piuttosto{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Ma se mi sbrigo, posso
sempre farli dopo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Ot Yolma Günü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} gelince nedense hep evi
temizliyorum ve ne
kadar zorlu olduğunu yeniden
hatırlıyorum!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Yeni yeni fark ediyorum{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}
annem benden çok daha güçlüymüş! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Hoy es el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Día del Hierbajo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! Por
eso, he decidido aprovechar para
hacer algo de limpieza en casa.
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}¡Vaya! Acabo de limpiar en ese
sitio de ahí,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000C:}}pero ya está todo
pisoteado{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Puisqu'aujourd'hui, on nettoie la
ville, j'en ai profité pour faire le
ménage à fond,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Argh !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est des traces de pas que
je vois, là ?!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:000C:}}Pfff, je venais tout
juste de faire ce coin{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Oggi è la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Giornata delle erbacce{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}...
e io ho lucidato casa dentro e fuori.
Ormai è tradizione, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Ehi! Ma lì avevo appena passato
lo straccio!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000C:}}Di chi sono quelle
impronte???
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Heute ist der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Tag des Jätens{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Ich hab mein Haus geputzt.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Das ist fast wie Jäten, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder?
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Hey! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Da drüben hab ich doch gerade
erst gewischt!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000C:}}Wer ist denn da
schon wieder drübergetrampelt?!
